Call `/verticals` with delivery coordinates and choose the desired catalog from its `store_ids` map. Store ids vary by location and catalog; reuse the selected id when browsing products and checking their details or stock.
An unknown or unsupported store can return an empty result. If discovery looks unexpectedly empty, check the store selection first.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description:
Preferred language for localized restaurant and discovery content. Optional.

- `en`  -  English (default)
- `ar`  -  Arabic

Omission or blank uses `en`. Retail product, category and brand records retain both `name` and `name_ar`; use the field your application needs.
Numeric inventory data is unchanged. Some display text may retain its published language.
